primary.usage: Deep mode: headers, the current-task card, timer ring. Reads as still, weighty — the 'protected' color.

secondary.usage: Shallow mode: badges, quick-win chips, the hidden-count pill. Reads as light, quick, low-stakes.

accent.usage: Active/interactive accents: Focus Mode toggle when ON, primary buttons, focus rings.

background.usage: App background. Warm off-white, not stark white, so brand colors don't fight the canvas.

surface.usage: Cards and panels sitting on top of the background.

text.usage: Primary text color, near-black for contrast on light surfaces.

muted.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, done/struck-through task labels.
